en.headline: Police arrest domestic helper over alleged ill-treatment of child at Belcher's
en.dek: A 37-year-old Philippine helper was arrested after the mother of a four-year-old girl reported suspected mistreatment at a Kennedy Town flat; the child has no visible injuries.
body: Police arrested a 37-year-old Philippine domestic helper on Friday on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child in her care at Belcher's in Kennedy Town.

Officers received a report from the mother of a four-year-old girl at about 9:30 am on Friday, saying she suspected her daughter had been treated inappropriately. After a preliminary investigation, police said the helper was suspected of spitting into the child's food. The girl has no visible injuries and did not need hospital treatment.

The case is being handled by the Western District Criminal Investigation Team 4. According to reports citing the mother's review of home closed-circuit television, the helper was seen spitting into a cup of milk prepared for the girl on at least four occasions between 31 October and 5 November. The helper has been detained for investigation.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城寶翠園外傭涉虐兒被捕 疑向女童食物吐痰
zh.dek: 警方周五早上接獲四歲女童母親報案，指懷疑女兒被不恰當對待，拘捕37歲菲傭；女童無表面傷，毋須送院。
body: 警方周五拘捕一名37歲菲律賓籍外傭，涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略。事發於堅尼地城薄扶林道89號寶翠園。
警方表示，早上約9時半接獲四歲女童母親報案，指懷疑女兒被不恰當對待。初步調查後，外傭疑在女童食物中吐口水。女童沒有表面傷，毋須送院。
案件由西區警區刑事調查隊第四隊跟進。據報，女戶主翻查家中閉路電視後發現，外傭於10月31日至11月5日期間至少四次在為女童沖奶時向杯中吐痰。被捕外傭正被扣留調查。
